values.meaning: bonus magic damage on empowered attack/bolt
values.quote: {{pp|16; then +4*x for 5; then +6*x for 5; then +8*x for 3; then +10*x for 6|color=magic damage|formula=16 base, then +4 per level until level 6, then +6 per level until level 11, then +8 per level until level 14, then +10 per level}} {{as|(+ 20% AP)}}

mechanics.claim: After casting an ability, Zoe's next basic attack or Spell Thief bolt within 5 seconds is empowered to deal bonus magic damage and becomes non-projectile.
mechanics.quote: After casting an {{tip|ability}}, '''Zoe''' empowers her next {{tip|basic attack}}<!--not on-hit?--> or ''{{ai|Spell Thief|Zoe}}'' bolt within 5 seconds to become {{tip|projectile|non-projectile}} and deal ... {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack triggers but is not consumed when used against wards.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attack will trigger but not be consumed against {{tip|wards}}.
